def rays(fours, div, shape, dirs):
    H,W=shape; out=set()
    for (r,c) in fours:
        for dr,dc in dirs:

                if nr<0 or nr>=H: break
                if (nr,nc)==(r,c): break
                out.add((nr,nc))
                rr,cc=nr,nc
                if len(out)>200: break
    return out

    R=None
    for r,row in enumerate(inp):
        if all(v==2 for v in row): R=r
    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0])
    cells=set()
    for r in range(R):

                if nr==R-1:  # adjacent to 2-row after shift

    for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=4
    return out
